Iran Attacks Bahrain, Kuwait After US Strikes; Oil Tankers Divert

Following U.S. strikes and the revocation of Iran's oil export license, Iran launched attacks on sites in Bahrain and Kuwait. Air raid sirens were heard in Bahrain, and explosions were reported. The conflict has also led to at least four oil and gas tankers diverting from the Strait of Hormuz, raising concerns about global oil supplies and ongoing negotiations.
